page.overview:
What is Classic Animatronics?

The Classic animatronics are the local robot entertainers of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza and the very first animatronics to be introduced in the Five Nights at Freddy's series. The group consists of four animatronic animals: Freddy Fazbear, Bonnie the Rabbit, Chica the Chicken, and Foxy the Pirate. Their first prototypes were commissioned by Fazbear Entertainment to be built by Edwin Murray in the 1970s. However, due to him going "missing," the project was picked up and finished by Henry Emily.

The animatronics first appeared in the original Five Nights at Freddy's game as the main antagonists, then returned in Five Nights at Freddy's 2 as old and broken iterations referred to as Withered animatronics. While appearing in Five Nights at Freddy's 3, Five Nights at Freddy's 4, Sister Location, Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator, Security Breach, Help Wanted 2 and Secret of the Mimic as cameos, they returned in Ultimate Custom Night, Help Wanted, and Special Delivery as prominent antagonists. They've also appeared in the novel trilogy, Fazbear Frights series, Tales from the Pizzaplex series, Interactive Novel series, and the film series. The Fazbear Fanverse also feature their own iterations of the Classics, those being in POPGOES and Five Nights at Freddy's Plus.

The Classic animatronics use a very simple design, with suits are made of fabric and filled with crossbeams, wires and other animatronic parts placed on metal endoskeletons. Giving the impression of cartoon animals, they wear accessories and have four fingers per hand. They also have a single set of teeth on the lower jaw, with the exception of Foxy, who also has teeth on the upper jaw. Said teeth are square in the cases of Freddy and Chica, but are round for Bonnie and sharp & triangular for Foxy.

In the first game, the animatronics supposedly wander about Freddy Fazbear's Pizza after-hours in a "free-roaming mode" (due to their servos locking up if they stay in place for too long) and sometimes coming after the protagonist Mike Schmidt. This is confirmed by Ralph during his call on Night 1.
